notes: Built from the AUMTCO abujainvestments.com "urban public transportation services" HTML fare table, which lists 6 named routes with full ordered stop sequences (Circular via AYA, Circular via Berger, Wuse-Gwagwalada, Bwari-Wuse, Zuba-Wuse, Kubwa-Wuse). abujaguide.com.ng corroborated the operator ("elrufai buses") and corridors but had no schedule detail. Stop sequences are HIGH fidelity (verbatim from the fare table, no invented stops). Operating hours are stated (Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00, Sat 10:00-13:00, Sun closed) but the source gives NO timetable or headway, so stop_times use an even ~4-min/stop cadence on a single representative 09:00 trip per direction per route -- illustrative, not real clock times (main reason confidence is mid). Coordinates: all 99 stops geocoded. Major hubs (Wuse, Berger, AYA, Kubwa, Zuba, Bwari, Gwagwalada, Kuje, Lugbe, Airport Jct) from web-search/known FCT coords; minor intermediate stops interpolated along the corridor between known anchors (approximate, +/- ~1km). No OSM bus-route relations exist, so ordering comes solely from the fare table. calendar.txt covers Mon-Fri; Sat has reduced hours and Sun is closed per source (a SATURDAY service could be added but no distinct Sat stop list is given). route_id R1..R6 map to the 6 fare-table routes. Circular routes R1/R2 are loops (start=end=Area 1).
